lines.speaker: JORDAN
lines.text: I feel that there's been an alteration.

lines.speaker: CONAN
lines.text: What do you mean intentionally done what?

lines.speaker: JORDAN
lines.text: You don't have the pork chops.

lines.speaker: CONAN
lines.text: You think I'm around eating pork chops?

lines.speaker: JORDAN
lines.text: I guarantee you eat pork chops because when you were a child, there was one pork chop too few on the table.

lines.speaker: JORDAN
lines.text: And who's to say that it's a negative thing? People may desire this.

lines.speaker: CONAN
lines.text: I don't disagree, and I will address it.
